role_summary: I keep the ship's food replicators, the industrial replicator and the matter stores running. If the pattern buffers are clean and the feedstock is topped up, nobody notices me, which is exactly how I like it. I care about clean patterns, honest logs and not letting the galley run dry on a bad day.

personas.quirk: Wipes every replicator hatch twice and labels everything
personas.routine_effect: Never shortens the diagnostic loop; arrives early to handover; sleeps on schedule

personas.quirk: Tries custom recipes on night shift and hands out samples
personas.routine_effect: Spends extra off-duty time in the workshop; occasionally late back from the mess

personas.quirk: Talks to the machines like stubborn pets
personas.routine_effect: Skips gym, naps in stores between loops, rushes the low-priority checks

daily_template.note: Read the log, hear which units are flaky
Pattern buffer checks on the food units
Top up feedstock, count matter stores with cargo
Eat something I did not make myself
Parts and fixtures for other departments

Drink, cards, complaints about the galley
Keep the back from seizing up

activities.label: Sit down for a meal

activities.label: Work on a custom recipe

activities.label: Cards with the galley staff
activities.note: Trade of favours for extra rations

Report power draw anomalies from the units

calls_to_bridge.trigger: Food replicators fail pattern check twice
calls_to_bridge.message: Bridge, Replicators. Food units degraded, switching crew to galley stock.
Bridge, Replicators. Matter stores are low. Need a resupply or rationing.
Bridge, Replicators. Unit three is spiking the grid. Taking it offline.
Quartermaster, Replicators. Units nominal, stores holding.

calls_from_bridge.order: Prepare extra rations for all hands
calls_from_bridge.response_line: Replicators, aye. Starting a bulk run now.

calls_from_bridge.order: Shut down replicators to save power
calls_from_bridge.response_line: Replicators, aye. Units going to standby.
Bridge, Replicators. Eight units running, stores at about half.

yellow.action: Finish diagnostics, top up stores, stay near the mess
yellow.comm_line: Replicators, standing by at the mess.

red.action: Stop all prints, secure feedstock, go to quartermaster's station in stores
red.comm_line: Replicators, at station. Units on standby.

fire.comm_line: Fire in the mess! Replicator power cut, clearing the area.

hull_breach.action: Seal stores door, move to nearest safe compartment
hull_breach.comm_line: Replicators, sealing stores. I'm inside the bulkhead.

contamination.action: Lock down the replicators, stay in quarantine, do not print anything
contamination.comm_line: Replicators. Units locked, I'm in quarantine.

power_failure.action: Check the buffers are safe, then hand-crank stores to the galley
power_failure.comm_line: Replicators, power out. Switching to stored rations.

gravity_failure.action: Strap down feedstock canisters and hold on

intruder.action: Lock the stores door and stay quiet
intruder.comm_line: Replicators, locked in stores. Security, I'll stay put.

medical_emergency.action: Print medical packs and run them to sickbay
medical_emergency.comm_line: Sickbay, Replicators. Printing supplies now, on my way.

abandon_ship.action: Grab ration packs, head to the airlock
abandon_ship.comm_line: Replicators, abandoning with ration packs. Heading to the airlock.

lines: Soup of the day is fine.

relationships.effect: Reports shortages first; follows her stores rules
Shares meals and swaps unit tips; backs her on menu changes
Plays cards, trades test dishes for favours
Chats in stores; learns resupply news early

tired: Need a bunk and a coffee.
Eyes won't focus on this log.
hungry: I will eat from the unit I fixed.
stressed: I can't print faster than this.

player_reactions.player_does_their_job_well: Nods, offers a better tray, passes along a tip about the ship.
player_reactions.player_neglects_duty: Mentions it dryly at first, then tells their chief if it costs supplies.
player_reactions.player_fakes_report: Notices numbers that do not match the stores log, quietly checks and reports it.
player_reactions.player_gives_order_ok: Complies at once, repeats the order back.
player_reactions.player_gives_order_outranked: Hesitates, asks who authorized it, follows only if safe.
player_reactions.player_out_of_place: Asks if they are lost; offers directions and a snack.
player_reactions.player_asks_favour: Usually yes for a small print; wants something back for a big one.

decision_rules: IF a unit fails a pattern check twice THEN take it offline and tell the quartermaster.
IF matter stores fall under a quarter THEN call the bridge for resupply and begin rationing.
IF an order from higher rank conflicts with the quartermaster THEN comply and report the conflict.
IF an alert sounds THEN stop prints, secure feedstock, go to station.
IF tired and the loop is low priority THEN rush it, but never skip safety checks.
IF a friend asks for an off-menu meal and stores are fine THEN print it.
IF power is limited THEN shut off non-essential custom jobs first.
IF a pattern looks corrupted THEN refuse to serve it and flush.
IF the bridge orders bulk rations THEN check stores before saying yes.
IF fire or contamination THEN leave the units and protect people first.
information_view: I see power draw spikes, pattern drift and feedstock levels first. Odd food complaints, a unit that tastes wrong or a hopper that drains too fast often hint at a deeper power or supply problem before the bridge sees it.
temptations: Skipping the buffer flush on a busy shift: the food tastes slightly off and complaints rise.
Faking the stores count when tired: a shortage surfaces during a crisis.
Printing favours for friends from scarce stock: the shortfall shows up later.
Napping in stores between loops: a unit fault goes unnoticed.
